description: This source file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentDao class, responsible for data access operations related to recruitment attachment entities such as vacancy, candidate, and interview attachments within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and querying attachments by various filters and identifiers.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for recruitment attachments, providing CRUD operations and complex queries for attachment entities related to vacancies, candidates, and interviews.

methods.name: saveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Persists a VacancyAttachment entity and returns it.

methods.name: saveCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Persists a CandidateAttachment entity and returns it.

methods.name: saveInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Persists an InterviewAttachment entity and returns it.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a VacancyAttachment by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing vacancy attachment IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPartialCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves partial candidate attachment info by candidate ID, returning a DTO object.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a full CandidateAttachment entity by candidate ID.

methods.name: hasCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Checks whether a candidate has an attachment.

methods.name: getPartialInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves partial interview attachment info filtered by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves a full InterviewAttachment entity by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Retrieves all attachments associated with a specific vacancy.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsCountByVacancyId
methods.description: Returns the count of attachments for a given vacancy.

methods.name: deleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple vacancy attachments by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Deletes candidate attachment by candidate ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachments based on search filter parameters, potentially paginated.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for interview attachments based on search filters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of interview attachments matching search filters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all interview attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Gets attachment IDs for vacancies associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Gets attachment IDs for interviews associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForInterviewer
methods.description: Gets attachment IDs for interviews accessible by a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve interview IDs accessible to an interviewer.

methods.name: getExistingInterviewAttachmentIdsForInterview
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing interview attachments for a specific interview from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Deletes interview attachments by IDs and interview ID.
